title: GTA 6 Launch is Two Weeks Away as Rockstar Drops 37 New Screenshots
description: With the PS5 release just two weeks away, Rockstar Games has released 37 brand new screenshots showcasing Vice City and the world beyond.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Launch is Two Weeks Away as Rockstar Drops 37 New Screenshots

We are now officially just two weeks away from finally getting our hands on GTA 6. To celebrate this massive milestone as the PS5 release draws ever closer, developer Rockstar Games has shared another substantial batch of screenshots designed to showcase Vice City and the expansive world beyond at its absolute best.

### A Massive Batch of 37 New Screenshots

Reported by gaming media outlet Push Square, Rockstar has treated the global gaming community to a whopping 37 new screenshots. For a community that has spent years analyzing every single pixel of previous trailers and image drops, this latest gallery offers an unprecedented look at what to expect when the game finally arrives.

The screenshots focus heavily on highlighting the vibrant atmosphere of Vice City, capturing its distinct architectural style, bustling urban environments, and stunning lighting details. Beyond the city limits, the images also give fans a glimpse of the diverse surrounding world that players will be able to explore.

### The Final Countdown Begins

As the release date approaches in just two weeks, the excitement surrounding GTA 6 has reached a fever pitch. These new visual assets serve as a strong reminder of the technical leap and detailed open-world design that Rockstar has been crafting. For players eagerly awaiting the PS5 launch, the countdown is officially in its final, most agonizingly exciting stage.

## Editor's Take
Dropping 37 new screenshots just two weeks before launch is a masterclass in hype management from Rockstar. It feeds the community's insatiable appetite for new content while keeping anticipation at an all-time high. The wait is almost over, and Vice City is ready to welcome us back.
